algorithm.C: All known triangles, corner order, winding and FP32 bits retained; distinct known anchors never merged.
algorithm.CF: Exactly one distinct C anchor within radius: snap free corner; multiple: reject and keep corner immutable.
algorithm.FF: Lexicographically ordered immutable original-point representatives; nearest existing within radius, no transitive chaining or averaging.
algorithm.delete: Only free exact repeated-vertex / collinear triangles, and unordered exact duplicates with C preferred.
algorithm.limitation: Paper-inspired nominal [-.95,.95] reference-space radius, not a verified reproduction of the authors full denoiser/welding runtime units.
algorithm.units: x_model=2*x_unitbox/.3762; reference convention x_ref=1.9*x_unitbox=.95*.3762*x_model. Fixed globally; no output-bbox normalization.

denoiser.reason: No verified learned mesh-denoiser code/weight identity in maintained local assets or checked published README.

evaluation.fixed_queries: Original C/GT/Gamma/directions files copied byte-for-byte; no new seeds or target queries.
evaluation.geometry: Original S/I/E and quality formulas applied to variable free-face count. Original N and final N both reported.
evaluation.hypothesis: Small bounded changes and connectivity cleanup may improve local seams/intersections without sacrificing C or main-shape fidelity.
evaluation.inference: Descriptive on already observed eight DEV parents/four noises; no new-parent generalization or promotion.
evaluation.predicted_surface_queries: Original fixed seeds and area-sampling algorithm applied to each output surface; positions change with surface, as required by original F-to-GT definition.
evaluation.raw: 32 identity-verified frozen score rows; original vectors retained
evaluation.topology: True exported vertex-index connectivity plus exact-coordinate RAW connectivity diagnostic; distinct from geometric seam coverage.

runtime.additional_workers: Measured CPU/RAM after first registered case; cap four to leave headroom.

stop: Exactly one fixed cleanup of the 32 retained START outputs; all evidence delivered, no default switch, training, generation, commit or push.
